extraction_notes: Gross Fiscal Deficit, Revenue Deficit, Primary Deficit, Debt, Interest % Revenue Receipts, Capital Outlay % GSDP, Revenue Receipts % GSDP, Own Tax Revenue % GSDP, GSDP, and Outstanding Debt are from Executive Summary (Page 13), Chapter 1 tables (1.1, 1.3, 1.7, 1.8, 1.10, 1.28, 1.30), and Fiscal Health Indicators Table (Page 110). Audit paras raised this year (excess expenditure) is from Table 2.2 (Page 74). Audit paras outstanding over 5 years (from 2018-19, meaning 2013-14 and prior) are calculated from Table 2.4 (Page 122). PAC recommendations pending refers to the 32 grants and appropriations for which explanatory notes were discussed by PAC but regularization is pending (Page 76). Money value of observations is taken from outstanding Utilisation Certificates (UCs) as it is the largest value explicitly stated for observations (Page 94, Table 3.6).
